Gutsy.description: Possessing fierce determination and resilience against fear.

features.name: Gutsy Halfling
features.tldr: You gain bonuses on saves against fear effects and bounce back quickly.

Nomadic.description: Raised traveling the roads, highly adaptable to shifting environments.

features.name: Nomadic Halfling
features.tldr: You gain extra training in survival skills and resistance to travel fatigue.
